hits.description:
To use this launcher you have to own Minecraft: Bedrock Edition on google play store, you may be unable to play the latest update of the Game. Otherwise you will get an license error while launching the google play apk.
        
      
            This is an unofficial Linux launcher for the Minecraft Bedrock codebase. This project is not affiliated with Minecraft, Mojang or Microsoft.
        
      Not available Features you may miss
      
        Xbox live friend joining - Technically Working on Linux - usually times out or crashs the game in both directions - consider using the offical server software www.minecraft.net/en-us/download/server/bedrock - connect all by ip as external server
        Xbox live login - a lot of devices seem to get error code "drowned" without beeing asked for login - error code "drowned" has more meanings like you closed the webview window without sign in - try to change your timezone to a different one
hits.name: Minecraft Bedrock Launcher
hits.summary: Download and play Minecraft Bedrock Edition on GNU/Linux

hits.description:
X Minecraft Launcher (XMCL) is a feature-rich Minecraft launcher that lets you manage
      resources like modpacks, resource packs, mods, and shader packs. It integrates with Minecraft
      Forge, Fabric, Quilt, CurseForge, and Modrinth.
    
      Key features:
      
        ⚡️  Blazing-Fast Downloads: Concurrent multi-part downloads with HTTP/HTTPS socket reuse for maximum speed
        📚 Isolated Multi-Instancing: Create conflict-free environments for mods, versions, and custom configurations
        🗂 Smart Resource Management: Zero-duplication storage using hard/symbolic links to optimize disk space
        📦 One-Click Modpacks: Fully compliant import/export for CurseForge & Modrinth collections
        🔧 Direct Mod Integration: Browse and install individual mods from CurseForge & Modrinth
        ⚙️  All Major Mod Loaders: Native support for Forge, Fabric, and Quilt frameworks
        🎨 Visual Enhancement Hub: Unified management for resource packs, shader packs, and texture packs
        👥 Multi-Account Hub: Seamless switching between Microsoft, Mojang, and third-party accounts
        🌐 Serverless Multiplayer: Built-in peer-to-peer hosting for instant game sharing
hits.name: X Minecraft Launcher

hits.description:
Prism Launcher is a custom launcher for Minecraft that focuses on predictability, long term stability and simplicity.
      Features:
      
        Easily install game modifications, such as Fabric, Forge and Quilt
        Easily install and update modpacks from the Launcher
        Control your Java settings, and enable Mangohud or Gamemode with a toggle
        Manage worlds and resource packs from the launcher
        See logs and other details easily through a dashboard
        Kill Minecraft in case of a crash/freeze
        Isolate Minecraft instances to keep everything clean
        Install and update mods directly from the launcher
        Customize the launcher with themes, and more
        And cat :3
hits.name: Prism Launcher
hits.summary: Custom Minecraft Launcher to easily manage multiple Minecraft installations at once

hits.description:
A unique, open source Minecraft launcher that allows you to play your favorite mods, and keep them up to date, all in one neat little package.
      Modrinth App is the easiest way to install and play content from Modrinth with whatever Minecraft version or mod loader you'd like. With first-party support for shared instances, friends, and Modrinth Hosting, Modrinth App aims to make playing with friends just as easy as playing singleplayer.
      You can sync your settings across instances, making it quicker than ever to jump right into a new modpack. Browse for servers and join them (yes, even modded ones) with just a click. Customize and switch between your skins, with added support for the Ears mod! View all your screenshots in one place, and manage your Modrinth Hosting servers all without ever leaving the app.
hits.name: Modrinth App

hits.description:
CurseForge is the home for game modding. Browse and install mods, modpacks,
      resource packs, worlds, and addons for Minecraft and other supported games,
      and keep them up to date — all from one app.
    
      Features:
      
        Browse and one-click install mods and modpacks
        Create, manage, and launch modded game profiles
        Automatic updates for your installed content
        Import and export modpacks to share with others
      
      
      CurseForge is free to use, and every feature listed above works without paying.
      The app shows ads. An optional paid subscription removes them and unlocks
      cosmetic extras; it is not required for any of the functionality above.
hits.name: CurseForge
